_NOTE: INSTALL SoT (2026-07-16): 'recommend: install' entries here are RESEARCH verdicts, not install state. The single source of truth for what is ACTUALLY installed on this machine is visual_gate/README.md's table (~8 tools as of 06-21; Playwright/Ollama deferred). Install the rest on-demand at EQUIP when a project needs the modality.

name: claude -p separate-critic gate
capability: Fresh-context VLM judge with no build stake; runs the refute-biased structured-verdict prompt. The keystone anti-lying mechanism.
why: Self-grading is where the lie is born; a stakeless fresh judge + default-FAIL prompt converts 'looks good' into a localized defect list. Already proven in a 3D-game pipelinl director_review.py/art_review.py — zero new install.

name: Perception canary
capability: Read a control image with a secret token; verdict VOID (PERCEPTION-BLIND) if not reported verbatim.
why: Native Read->vision channel is documented-unreliable (issues #36488/#35866/#18588). Without the canary the gate certifies images the model never saw = more lying.

name: DeepEval MultimodalGEval
capability: Turnkey VLM-as-judge harness; G-Eval auto-CoT eval steps; swappable local/Claude judge.
why: Best orchestration skeleton, but PostHog/Sentry telemetry ON by default — set DEEPEVAL_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT=1 or use deepeval-no-telemetry fork before adopting.

name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B (Ollama)
capability: Strong local VLM judge for charts/docs/layout; runs the refute-biased rubric offline/free.
why: Makes the gate genuinely free+local at scale. Pin :7b — 3B=Research(non-commercial), 72B=capped license. claude -p stays the escalation tier for subtle defects.

name: LLaVA-Critic
capability: Dedicated multimodal critic (feedback-then-score), aligns with GPT-4o rankings.
why: Maintained successor to Prometheus-Vision; use when a general VLM is too lenient.

name: Prometheus-2 rubric prompts
capability: Feedback-then-score rubric templates to port into the vision judge prompt.
why: Text judge (does not see) but its rubric structure is the best free template for the describe-then-score protocol.

name: Moondream-0.5B
capability: Tiny VLM gross-defect tripwire (blank/missing-text/extra-limb).
why: ~1GB RAM disagreement detector; catches gross failure cheap. Run via transformers (0.5B not on Ollama). Misses fine defects — not a fine judge.

name: Playwright (+@playwright/mcp vision-mode)
capability: Headless browser capture across viewport x theme x DPI; drives modal/hover/scroll/empty/error states.
why: The project-agnostic web capture engine. CRITICAL: default snapshot = ARIA/DOM tree (text, not pixels) — must --caps=vision or screenshot+Read, else it's the lie vector.

name: just-every/mcp-screenshot-website-fast
capability: Web screenshot tiled to ~1072x1072 (1.15MP Claude-vision sweet spot), no caching.
why: Most vision-budget-aware web capture; best default for dashboards/landing pages.

name: erichowens playwright-screenshot-inspector
capability: Capture+Read loop with semantic (not pixel) judgment for web.
why: Best ready-made browser gate skill; still needs the canary + separate critic on top.

name: kmoulder/screen-capture-mcp
capability: Windows desktop/window capture returning inline PNG, fully local.
why: Owner is Windows. CAVEAT: GDI/BitBlt returns black on exclusive-fullscreen/HW-overlay — run UE5/Godot WINDOWED for the gate.

name: itrimble/image-viewer-mcp
capability: Deliver on-disk PNG/JPG/WebP to vision as a base64 image block.
why: Reliable SDXL/any-saved-render -> vision, bypassing flaky raw Read (oversized/transparent/HEIC -> dropped or session-corrupting 400).

name: pdf2image (+poppler)
capability: PDF page -> PNG (MIT-clean capture path).
why: Clean-license PDF capture; prefer over PyMuPDF when distribution matters.

name: PyMuPDF (fitz)
capability: Fastest PDF render + structural access.
why: Fast but AGPL — internal verification tooling only; switch to pdf2image if the gate ships as a service.

name: pdfplumber
capability: Per-char bbox overflow/clip/overlap deterministic FAIL signals.
why: The deterministic backbone for PDFs — a bbox-overflow hard-FAIL the VLM can't talk its way out of.

name: pytesseract + Tesseract
capability: OCR-vs-known-source-string mismatch = invisible/garbled-text FAIL.
why: Catches text rendered as hairline/invisible/wrong-font deterministically.

name: ffmpeg
capability: Frame extract past black leader, contact-sheet (tile), blackdetect, libvmaf.
why: Universal video capture + black-video guard + per-frame VMAF; tile filter makes the contact sheet with zero extra dep.

name: PySceneDetect
capability: Semantic keyframe selection (content/adaptive) — feed the judge the RIGHT frames.
why: Beats every-5s sampling; best free frame-selector.

name: claude-video-vision (Whisper-local)
capability: Frames -> Claude native vision via ffmpeg; on-device, no telemetry.
why: Default video spine; set Whisper-local, never enable cloud backend.

name: WhisperX
capability: Forced-alignment word timestamps -> caption_offset_ms deterministic gate.
why: Solves caption mis-timing numerically; skip pyannote diarization (CC-BY gated) — not needed for alignment.

name: odiff
capability: SIMD pixel-diff vs baseline (the un-rationalizable number).
why: Best objective regression primitive for UI/PDF-rerender/game frames; needs a golden baseline.

name: pixelmatch
capability: ISC pixel-diff, Node/browser pre-filter.
why: Cheap numeric pre-filter; gate the VLM only when diff% crosses threshold.

name: ez-img-diff
capability: SSIM CLI/API baseline-vs-current with where-changed output.
why: Python-stack SSIM alternative to odiff/pixelmatch.

name: diff-pdf (vslavik)
capability: PDF-vs-golden exit-code regression gate.
why: Maintained (v0.5.3), Windows prebuilt, clean CI 0/1 exit code.

name: CLIP-IQA (IQA-PyTorch)
capability: No-reference SEMANTIC image-quality score.
why: Content-aware no-baseline gate for SDXL. Use this NOT NIQE/BRISQUE — those are blind to extra limbs/garbled text.

name: LPIPS
capability: Reference-based perceptual similarity score.
why: Gen-image regression when a reference exists; needs PyTorch.

name: Q-Align / OneAlign
capability: 1-5 quality score for image/render/video (commercial-safe).
why: Use over DOVER/FAST-VQA for any commercial project (those are S-Lab non-commercial).

name: VMAF (ffmpeg libvmaf)
capability: Per-frame full-reference video quality; catches localized broken transitions.
why: Per-frame dip exposes a 2s broken transition the global average hides; needs a known-good baseline.

name: trimesh
capability: Mesh assertions: watertight, winding-consistent, fragment count, scale, degenerate faces.
why: Catches the mesh defects invisible in any beauty render, deterministically, <200ms — TRELLIS/Hunyuan3D/Blender gate.

name: Open3D
capability: Edge/vertex-manifold, orientable, self-intersection checks.
why: Covers the manifold checks trimesh doesn't expose directly.

name: pyrender
capability: Headless diagnostic renders: face-normal-RGB, wireframe, component-color grid.
why: Turns invisible mesh defects (flipped normals, holes, fragments) into a grid the VLM can actually judge.

name: PyMeshLab
capability: Repair: non-manifold edges, hole fill, re-orient, drop tiny components.
why: Attempt-repair-then-reassert before final FAIL; ManifoldPlus for severe topology.

name: recast-navigation-js
capability: WASM Recast+Detour navmesh build + findPath reachability in Node (no browser).
why: Catches unreachable rooms/broken corridors (a game's 'inside not explorable' bug) before any player loads — no screenshot can encode reachability.

name: rapier-node / @dimforge/rapier3d-compat
capability: Node WASM physics: capsule ground-settle + shape overlap probes.
why: Fall-through-floor + mesh interpenetration as numeric PASS/FAIL (web equivalent of UE5 sweep probes).

name: MediaPipe Pose
capability: Foot world-position over frames -> foot-slide numeric gate.
why: No OSS foot-slide DETECTOR exists; compute foot_dx vs root_dx on a planted contact frame. Smooth L/R heel/toe noise.

name: BackstopJS
capability: Matrix visual-regression report (viewport x scenario) with HTML diff.
why: Optional matrix-history regression for web; Playwright toHaveScreenshot covers most cases more simply.

name: Visual-Regression-Tracker
capability: Framework-agnostic HTTP API: submit ANY PNG (game/PDF/frame) for diff + approval dashboard.
why: Adopt ONLY if a regression-history dashboard is explicitly wanted; runs a DB+server = heavier. Regression, not first-render.

name: appium-mcp
capability: Drive Android/iOS emulator + get_screenshot_file (path, no base64 bloat).
why: Cleanest Claude-native mobile capture path; pair with black-frame detect + emulator -gpu swiftshader_indirect fix.

name: HADM (Human Artifact Detector)
capability: Detects human-figure artifacts (extra limbs/hands).
why: Narrow (human figures only) — good for stylized game avatars; verify weights license, runs local in a venv.

name: DOVER / FAST-VQA
capability: No-reference video quality score.
why: LICENSE TRAP — internal/research gating only; use Q-Align for any commercial project (any commercial artifact).

name: visual-explainer
capability: Generates HTML explainer reports.
why: WRONG MODALITY — produces HTML, does NOT perceive rendered output. Popular but useless for a perception gate.

name: vidlens-mcp
capability: YouTube intelligence/transcript; routes frames to Gemini.
why: Mis-cast as a render verifier; routes frames to Gemini (cloud key) = not free-local. Use ffmpeg + own model instead.

name: screen-view-mcp
capability: Screenshot then second paid outbound Claude Vision call.
why: Not free, opaque outbound call; kmoulder does it locally for free.

name: NIQE / BRISQUE
capability: No-reference low-level distortion (blur/noise/compression) score.
why: SEMANTICALLY BLIND — cannot detect extra limbs/garbled text/wrong fingers. Use CLIP-IQA for SDXL artifacts instead.
